annotation_policy.surface_items: Atomic exact source spans. Generic requirement wrappers are excluded; independently inspectable actions, objects, outcomes, and coordinated paths are retained.
annotation_policy.examples: Illustrative named instances attached to an upper-level requirement. Explicit one-of or one-or-more candidates remain surface items.
annotation_policy.shared_scope: A shared prefix, suffix, predicate, object, or evidence head is represented once and may apply to multiple atomic spans.
annotation_policy.prediction_independence: Labels were reviewed and frozen after the v3 parser hash freeze and before the parser was run on any selected source_text.
